headline: MIN @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.45 at PIT 4.36, with a projected total of 7.81. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PIT: MIN moved -1.95 runs while PIT moved -0.12, changing the projected margin by -1.82 runs. The projected total fell -2.07, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -6.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Braxton Ashcraft has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bryan Reynolds, Spencer Horwitz, Konnor Griffin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Outman, Ryan Kreidler because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
